caseName: Zicarelli v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation
caseNameFull: Zicarelli v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation
judges: Application, Consideration, Douglas, Granted, Should, That, Took

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. J. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 933.] Application for release on bail denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that the application should be granted. Mr. Justice Brennan took no part- in the consideration or decision of this application.
